relationships.subject: PSB-KK-1415
relationships.evidence_quote: The agonist PSB-KK-1415 at the highest dose tested (30 mg/kg) attenuated tactile allodynia in oxaliplatin-treated neuropathic mice.

relationships.subject: THC
relationships.evidence_quote: THC is not only a partial CB1/CB2 receptor agonist, but also a moderately potent agonist of GPR18 [6].

key_findings: GPR18 agonist PSB-KK-1415 (30 mg/kg) attenuated late-phase tactile allodynia in oxaliplatin-treated mice but not cold hyperalgesia.
GPR18 ligands did not mimic or alter THC discriminative effects or THC hypothermia.
